description: This file defines an interface for a hardware-optimized composition buffer in the WPEFramework's Exchange namespace. It includes nested structs for representing image planes and iterators, methods for managing buffer references, properties like dimensions and format, and methods for interacting with the buffer data.

classes.name: ICompositionBuffer
classes.description: An interface representing a composition buffer designed with hardware optimizations in mind, capable of managing multiple planes, buffer access, reference counting, and rendering functionalities.

classes.name: ICompositionBuffer::IPlane
classes.description: An interface representing a single image plane within the composition buffer, providing methods for accessing data, stride, and offset.

classes.name: ICompositionBuffer::IIterator
classes.description: An iterator interface to traverse the planes within the composition buffer.

methods.name: ~ICompositionBuffer
methods.description: Default destructor for the ICompositionBuffer interface.

methods.name: ~IPlane
methods.description: Default destructor for the IPlane interface.

methods.name: ~IIterator
methods.description: Default destructor for the IIterator interface.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increases the reference count for the buffer, managing its lifetime.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decreases the reference count and potentially deletes the buffer.

methods.name: Identifier
methods.description: Returns an identifier for the buffer.

methods.name: Planes
methods.description: Returns an iterator to access the planes of the buffer within a specified timeout.

methods.name: Completed
methods.description: Indicates that the caller is done with the planes, potentially signaling their readiness for display or processing.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Marks the buffer for scanout or display.

methods.name: Width
methods.description: Returns the width of the buffer in pixels.

methods.name: Height
methods.description: Returns the height of the buffer in pixels.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Returns the pixel format layout as per fourcc standards.

methods.name: Modifier
methods.description: Returns the pixel arrangement modifier used for hardware optimization.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the data type of the buffer (invalid, DMA, or raw).
